copy.title: deepin.risk · Company & Third-Party Investigation
copy.description: Investigate every company you depend on. deepin.risk continuously investigates companies through official records, financial information and external sources, and shows the evidence behind every change.
copy.hero_lede: Companies change. Ownership changes. Authority changes. Relationships change. Financial conditions change. Deepin continuously investigates those changes, gathers the evidence and shows you what matters.
copy.mon_h2: A company doesn't stay the same. Why should its risk report?
copy.mon_lede: Traditional risk assessment is a snapshot. Deepin maintains a living investigation.
copy.mon_explain: When a material event is detected, Deepin reopens the investigation, compares the new state with the company's history, collects the evidence and updates the risk context.
copy.dim_lede: Four questions, asked again every time something changes.
copy.ev_h2: Don't just show me the risk. Show me why.
copy.ev_lede: deepin.risk is not a black-box score. Every change in risk context comes with its findings, its sources and the reasoning that connects them.
copy.fit_lede: Your TPRM or GRC system manages the process. Deepin investigates the company behind it.
copy.fit_note: Deepin works alongside your existing risk stack.
copy.proof_lede: The same Company Investigation capability runs for each of these customers. Each is shown at the maturity it has actually reached.
copy.ent_h2: Built for the data you cannot send outside.
copy.ent_data_p: Your watchlists, investigations and decisions remain yours. What improves across deployments is how Deepin investigates, never your records.
copy.cta_p: Give us a company your team already knows. We'll show you what Deepin finds, how it found it and the evidence behind it.
